description: Use this when the person is a property manager and you need the owner a case is for, or to list one owner’s cases. Input: optional `includeArchived`. Returns the organization’s landlords (the owners it acts for, saved in the app), by name, each with its `id`, `name`, whether it is `archived` and how many cases in this mode name it; their contact details stay in the app. Live keys only: with a test key the list is always empty, since landlords are real owners, and a test case cannot take one. Do not use this to add or change a landlord (the person does that on the Landlords page of the app). Next: evictions_create_case with `landlordId`, or evictions_list_cases with `landlordId`. Needs the person’s account: sign-in or an API key.

includeArchived.description: True to list archived landlords too. They keep their cases but cannot be chosen for a new one.

name: evictions_list_landlords
title: List landlords
